about_the_game:
STORY & CHALLENGES:

Relish the artistic yet unsettling world of Liminal Salvation where true fear comes out of sheer tranquillity, ever-present in the air and a worrying instinct that behind closed quarters, you are being watched by unseen forces.

The game puts to test your 'navigation skills' because finding the exit doesn't need letter reading, weapon picking or character interaction... but having a still mind in a very irrational world. 'Liminal Salvation' literally means getting out of oppressive spaces'. Since there is no guidance, no direction and certainly no easy escape, salvation from liminal oppression is possible should you wisely use 'intuitive skills' correctly.

GAME MECHANICS & CHARACTER PROGRESSION:

Game mechanics involve the players ability to run quicker, walk through shallow water's as well as dive deep inside any given waterbody. One can slide and literally jump over launchpads instead of climbing traditional ladders. 

Since the game is an amalgamation of random pool levels, your progress is determined by moving forward. You first explore of what resembles a school, perhaps a reminisce of the good old days where one was carefree at best and having fun was the only motto in life. Later, you become engrossed inside an enigmatic labyrinth where pin drop silence exists' in every nook and corner!

USP: Welcome to an eerie, otherworldly ambiance where you can explore as much as you want and admire the artistic craftsmanship of this debut project. A huge catalogue of tiled wall's & floorings show-off reflections. Decent focus has been put on choosing the right combinations of indoor-outdoor lighting. 

INSPIRATIONS: Built by solo developer using Unreal engine 5, my faith and inspiration came by case-studying 'Pools by Tensori', 'Anemoiapolis: Chapter 1 by Andrew Quist' and 'Dreamcore by Montraluz'...

PLAYTIME: Min. 1 Hour 15 Minutes up to 2 hours 30 minutes

SOUNDTRACK: Just the sound of distant water drip's and footstep echo's are heard through and through. The project uses AI generated sound for hardly twenty seconds at the end of the gameplay.

GAMEPLAY NOTE:  This is NOT a stupefying horror game with monster's jump scaring your wits out. Minimal use of user-interface, minimal dialogue, the game is best played under Ultra Settings.

content_descriptors.notes: Paranormal situations, a glance of demons from the eastern or middle eastern traditions.

name: Liminal Salvation

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 from around 2016 or later
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 or newer
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 7 from 2018 or later
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or newer
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: A loner's journey by foot is about to get lonelier and lengthier! Liminal Salvation puts you in a vast labyrinth of pools where finding the exit route will require nothing but patience & zeal. Will you be able to make it to the very end or out of exhaustion, give up the ghost?
